- [USER] User requested code to convert a YouTube video to a downloadable file for the computer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using the `pytube` library to download YouTube videos.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a code snippet to download a YouTube video using `pytube`:
  ```python
  import pytube

  url = 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ'
  yt = pytube.YouTube(url)
  video_stream = yt.streams.first()
  video_stream.download(filename='video')
  ```
- [USER] User confirmed the code worked but mentioned the video quality was bad and asked how to fix it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested selecting a different video stream with a higher resolution.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided an updated code snippet to select the highest resolution video stream:
  ```python
  video_stream = yt.streams.filter(progressive=True, file_extension='mp4').order_by('resolution').desc().first()
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that not all videos have multiple streams and that the highest resolution may not always be the best choice.
- [USER] User requested the full code.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided the complete code to download a YouTube video with the highest resolution:
  ```python
  import pytube

  url = 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ'
  file_name = 'video'
  yt = pytube.YouTube(url)
  video_stream = yt.streams.filter(progressive=True, file_extension='mp4').order_by('resolution').desc().first()
  video_stream.download(filename=file_name)
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mentioned that the code requires the `pytube` library to be installed using `pip install pytube`.
